title: Ocean Beach Rear Yard ADU
summary: Design and permit drawings for a new detached accessory dwelling unit constructed behind an existing single-family home in Ocean Beach. The project included complete architectural documentation, site planning, structural coordination, energy compliance, and permitting for the City of San Diego.
projectDetails: Dual sewage ejection pump system connected to the existing residence
Permeable parking space and entry patio
highlights: Detached ADU designed for a large Ocean Beach corner lot
Efficient two-bedroom layout with open living spaces
Coordinated structural, energy, and MEP documentation
Permit-ready construction documents for City approval
